difficulty_reason: The author obligation is an undirected sparse node-capacity reduction, where the prior directed construction does not prevent extra flow from crossing through other terminals. The supplied five-layer construction includes full saturation and first-passing path arguments, then a capacity amplification that limits all such detours while preserving a unit separation between the two outcomes. This combination and the resulting fine-grained parameter accounting require a new reduction core beyond a routine max-flow/min-cut exercise.
